hypothesis: The prospective Top20 hit advantage of fixed H101 reciprocal-rank fusion over freq_100 increases as disagreement between the two parent Top20 lists increases.

primary_estimand.interpretation: Change in H101-minus-global Top20 hits per target associated with five additional disagreement slots

sample.inferential_timing: One final analysis only after all 200 canonical target outcomes are complete; no interim inferential looks and no retuning.
sample.split_use: Report all three chronological splits separately. The final 50-target blind OOS slope is a prespecified directional consistency check; no separate p-value is tested on that split.

primary_test.method: One-sided block permutation test of the OLS slope, shuffling contiguous 20-target blocks of the paired response while keeping the prior-only disagreement predictor fixed.

uncertainty.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap of paired predictor/response observations

registered_secondary_tests: Paired H101 RRF minus freq_100 mean Top20 hits (two-sided exact sign-flip dynamic program)
Paired H101 RRF minus position_seed_mix_top20_v1 mean Top20 hits (two-sided exact sign-flip dynamic program)
Absolute H101 RRF Top20 hits against exact iid Hypergeometric(40,20,5) convolution
multiple_testing: Holm step-down across the four final inferential p-values: the three registered H101 Top20 endpoints plus the H102 disagreement-slope endpoint.
support_rule: Mechanistic support requires beta5 >= 0.10, Holm-adjusted H102 p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, and a positive descriptive slope in the final 50-target blind OOS split. This does not authorize engine promotion.
data_and_freeze_guards: Use only the existing H101 frozen Top20 and its two already-frozen parent Top20 lists as predictors.
For every target, all three freezes must be on the target date, precede 19:00 Europe/Rome, and the H101 freeze must follow both parent freezes.
Each parent history_cutoff must equal the latest canonical draw date strictly before that target.
The target outcome is joined only after it appears in the canonical archive; no pending outcome is read from shadow-row fields.
No missing freeze is reconstructed, no forecast row is edited, and no parent model is retuned.
No merge or model promotion is authorized.
next_action: Wait for the official 2026-11-10 result to enter the canonical archive; then append-only score the unchanged H101 freeze. Continue the fixed 200-target cohort and run final inference only when complete.
